answer: An agent economy can require each identity to lock a slashable bond before taking paid jobs. Peers build reputation from completed work, and a signed receipt lets anyone prove a fabricated claim and trigger a penalty. The bond is a costly signal: creating many identities multiplies capital at risk, while a whisper campaign cannot reclaim it. Sybils remain possible, but their attacker must fund every identity and risk losing its stake. A ferrous token could serve as the bond only if it is scarce and slashable.
